title: Transformer implementation depth
goal: Verify information flow and cached decoding before optimizing attention.

capstone.title: A verified decoder and cache
capstone.environment: Colab / PyTorch; CPU first, GPU profiling later
steps: Implement next-token inputs, a small causal decoder and explicit position handling.
Compare full-prefix and cached logits at every step, including offset and capacity edge cases.
Profile a fixed workload only after correctness tests pass.
acceptance: Future tokens cannot change earlier outputs.
Cached/full logits agree within a stated dtype-specific tolerance.
Record source, seed, shapes, environment and actual measurements; no invented GPU results.

title: Reliable training and post-training
goal: Prove data, loss and recovery contracts before SFT, QLoRA or preference optimization.

capstone.title: A reproducible specialization experiment
capstone.environment: Colab GPU with persistent checkpoints; browser exercises prepare the components
steps: Validate independent source-group splits and inspect tokenizer-aligned assistant labels.
Overfit a tiny verified set, then compare interrupted/resumed training with a controlled baseline.
Evaluate base and adapter on an untouched suite under identical decoding before considering DPO or GRPO.
acceptance: No retained example has zero supervised causal targets.
Record actual checkpoint, optimizer, RNG and sampler recovery evidence.
Publish measured quality/regressions and hardware/resource metadata; clearly label smoke data.

title: Inference systems interview
goal: Connect cache ownership, scheduling, quantization and measured latency/throughput.

capstone.title: A measured inference comparison
capstone.environment: Local inference or available Colab GPU; no permanent hosted GPU required
steps: Freeze a representative request distribution, model revision and decoding settings.
Compare baseline and one serving/quantization change with cancellation and cache-isolation tests.
Separate queue delay, prefill, decode, startup and steady-state measurements.
acceptance: Report p50/p95 latency, throughput and memory from executed runs.
Preserve request isolation and check exported-model quality.
Explain one rejected optimization and the evidence behind that choice.

title: Evidence-driven AI systems
goal: Build retrieval and tool execution contracts, then test complete workflows and recovery.

capstone.title: A recoverable, evaluated tool workflow
capstone.environment: Local deterministic sandbox; optional model integration after component tests
steps: Version evidence and enforce permissions before retrieval results reach generation.
Implement an idempotent tool workflow with durable state and bounded retries.
Inject prompt instructions, timeout-after-effect and runtime interruption; score environment state and violations.
acceptance: Replaying a completed operation produces no duplicate effect.
Untrusted documents cannot expand execution authority.
Report success, safety violations, recovery and cost separately across repeatable trials.
